# jenkins_kubernetes_cloud (Resource)

Manages a Jenkins Kubernetes Cloud through the Jenkins Cloud configuration endpoints. Requires Overall/Administer and the Kubernetes plugin. Cloud settings outside the resource schema use Jenkins defaults on apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jenkins_kubernetes_cloud" "project" {
  name             = "project-agents"
  namespace        = "project-agents"
  credentials_id   = "project-provisioner"
  jenkins_url      = "https://jenkins.example.com/"
  usage_restricted = true
  websocket        = true
}

resource "jenkins_folder" "project" {
  name                        = "project"
  permitted_kubernetes_clouds = [jenkins_kubernetes_cloud.project.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Jenkins configuration object name.

### Optional

- `agent_registry` (String) Registry prefix for the default Jenkins agent image.
- `container_cap` (String) Maximum agent count as a positive integer string. Omit for the plugin default.
- `credentials_id` (String) Jenkins credential ID used to connect to Kubernetes.
- `jenkins_url` (String) URL agents use to connect to the controller.
- `namespace` (String) Default Kubernetes namespace for agent Pods.
- `server_certificate` (String) PEM certificate for the Kubernetes API server.
- `server_url` (String) Kubernetes API server URL. Omit for in-cluster discovery.
- `usage_restricted` (Boolean) Grant Cloud usage only to authorized Folders. Defaults to true.
- `websocket` (Boolean) Connect agents to Jenkins over WebSocket.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Jenkins configuration object identifier.
